notes.title: Developer Stream #5 - Re-Clash of Titans!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/a60384a670999565453b8619cd64ca245c74a396.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings Commanders![/h3]
Last week’s match with Jackson and Byron was so epic, we’re bringing Jackson back for a re-clash of the titans! This weekend he will be facing off against Ars Victor founder and creator Mike Bott. Two veteran strategic minds will meet on the battlefield again, and once more with live commentary! Ars Victor creator and developer Steve DeBaun will be breaking down the action, explaining the game, and providing analysis of the brilliant ploys and counter-attacks we’re bound to see this weekend.

Check out the match this [b][b]Saturday, January 30th at 11AM PST[/b][/b]. Join the chat from our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380860/Ars_Victor_Digital/]Store Page[/url] and talk with the developers while we play. We’ll be there to answer all your questions about the game. See you on the battlefield Commander!


If you'd like to catch up on the Developer Stream series, including last week’s epic battle between two Ars Victor all-timers, all of our previous broadcasts are available on our YouTube channel:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8eWEwqpzstzBYsFd1VPWpQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/b9e9ece64bfcad7f8c4520f0ea5cf2bb16ba222b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Developer Stream #4 - Veteran Strategy Showcase
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/a79a472e8104bf39e16a5dbcc43ea578b5476998.jpg[/img]

In our Developer Series we’ve shown you the basics of the game, what to do in a standard game, and how to get started. In our next episode we’d like to showcase strategic planning and execution. To help us with that we’re bringing in some Ars Victor veterans from the past.

Joining us this weekend will be Byron Sturtevant and Jackson Sauthaff. Byron and Jackson are two of the most knowledgeable Ars Victor players--former tournament runners and champions. This showcase will reunite two of the best players in the world and is sure to be a great one! Calling this battle of the titans will be Ars Victor creators Mike Bott and Steve DeBaun, providing commentary and analysis as well as answering any questions from the chat. Join us this [b][b]Sunday, January 24th at 12PM PST[/b][/b] for the fun! See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Developer Stream #3 - Happy New Year from Trip West Games!
notes.content:
[h3]Happy New Year Commanders![/h3] We hope you had a happy and healthy holiday season and are ready to welcome 2021 with us. This year will see the Early Access release of Ars Victor Digital! Improvements to basic gameplay, bug fixes, and minor design updates are being rolled out to alpha testers each week. Right now the big focus of the development team is on the new single-player campaign mode. Look for more screenshots and updates on that project over the next few weeks.

To kick the new year off we’re bringing you the third installment of the Developer Stream Series. This weekend will feature Lead Audio Engineer Jonathan DeBaun vs Producer Alyson Lowe. Tune into the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380860/Ars_Victor_Digital/]Steam Store Page[/url] this [b][b]Saturday, January 2nd at 11AM PST[/b][/b] to watch the game, ask questions, and chat with the developers!

notes.title: Major Alpha Release and First Developer Stream
notes.content:
Big changes in the latest alpha release! This build features the debut of the completely reworked UI system with new tooltip and help features. Features seeing major updates in this release include the enemy and player status windows, the action log, the card well, the pause menu, and the main menu. Development has now begun on the single player campaign mode and is scheduled to be included in the next major release. With this current release we will be opening up more [url=#joinalpha]alpha tester spots[/url] and we need your help! Your feedback will help us catch bugs and refine development, keeping us on track for our Early Access release in a few months.


Here’s a peek at some of the new UI updates just released:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/b6e38dcae91aa35ca3842693e2653694eaa20712.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/58cc447da4fd735dc17d973e3e55aa56746b631a.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
The Ars Victor community will be heavily involved in this game. Beginning this [b][b]Saturday, November 28th at 11AM PST[/b][/b], we’re going to be bringing you weekly broadcasts featuring developer-led showcases of the latest development builds, introducing new features, mechanics, and artwork. Our first installment of the series will feature the creators of Ars Victor, Mike Bott and Steve DeBaun. Other developers will be on hand to provide commentary and answer your questions about the game. Just click on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380860/Ars_Victor_Digital/]store page[/url] to watch the broadcast and join the chat. We look forward to hearing from you!


Would you like to know more? Leave a question or your feedback for us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1380860/discussions/]Discussions[/url] page or join our Discord server and just say hi. We’re also streaming games a few times a week on our Twitch channel. Check us out!
